validation_gates.rule: Alpha input must match Frozen Beta exact snapshot identity and linked human freeze approval evidence
Every Alpha semantic namespace resolves to exactly one canonical owner; duplicate namespace rows fail before indexing
Compiled Rule IDs must match RULE_REGISTRY and reference existing owners without semantic redefinition
CURRENT/HANDOFF/LATEST may not self-promote to authority
Volatile repo/runtime/deploy claims require dated live evidence
Cross-repo refs must pin exact SHA and relation to main when making current-state claims
Frozen manifest OPEN plus repository HOLD constraints must survive Alpha unless explicitly evidence-resolved
Requirement -> owner -> implementation/evidence -> validation -> status trace must be reconstructable
Frozen Beta invariants and tests may not regress
Attack stale authority, silent promotion, bypass, evidence drift, routing ownership leakage and hosted-claim inflation
Canonical Alpha promotion, merge and deployment remain explicit human gates
Required whole-system pipelines have contiguous owner-bounded stage maps; POINTER_ONLY cannot satisfy areas A-F
Every app/engine row has owner or explicit owner gap, source, implementation/evidence refs, OPEN refs and independent claim dimensions
LOCAL infrastructure lane and post-freeze working deltas cannot imply whole-system or canonical completion

claim_rule: Claim dimensions are independently evidenced. No universal linear promotion order is inferred; each higher claim requires its own explicit evidence and prerequisites.
